mapper.select: SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS reimbursementId, r.reimbursement_no AS reimbursementNo, r.title, r.reason, r.status, r.version, r.reimburser_id AS reimburserId, r.reimburser_name AS reimburserName, r.reimburser_no AS reimburserNo, r.department_id AS departmentId, r.department_name AS departmentName, r.department_no AS departmentNo, r.company_id AS companyId, r.company_name AS companyName, r.company_no AS companyNo, r.business_type_id AS businessTypeId, r.business_type_name AS businessTypeName, r.subsidy_amount AS subsidyAmount, r.remarks, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM reimbursement r WHERE r.id = #{reimbursementId}

SELECT CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS tripId, t.traveler_id AS travelerId, t.traveler_name AS travelerName, t.departure_city AS departureCity, t.arrival_city AS arrivalCity, t.start_date AS startDate, t.end_date AS endDate, t.description FROM trip t WHERE t.reimbursement_id = #{reimbursementId}

SELECT CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS tripId, t.traveler_name AS travelerName, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(MIN(sc.calendar_date), '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sc.calendar_date), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS travelDateRange, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.calendar_date) AS subsidyDays, CONCAT(t.departure_city, '→', t.arrival_city) AS route, t.arrival_city AS subsidyCity, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.meal_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.meal_standard, 0) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sc.traffic_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.traffic_standard, 0) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sc.comm_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.comm_standard, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS applyAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.meal_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.meal_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sc.traffic_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.traffic_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sc.comm_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.comm_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS subsidyAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.meal_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.meal_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS mealSubsidyAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.traffic_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.traffic_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS trafficSubsidyAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.comm_checked = 1 THEN COALESCE(sc.comm_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS commSubsidyAmount FROM subsidy_calendar sc INNER JOIN trip t ON t.id = sc.trip_id WHERE sc.reimbursement_id = #{reimbursementId} GROUP BY t.id, t.traveler_name, t.departure_city, t.arrival_city
mapper.update: UPDATE reimbursement SET title = #{title}, reason = #{reason}, company_id = #{companyId}, company_name = #{companyName}, company_no = #{companyNo}, department_id = #{departmentId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, department_no = #{departmentNo}, reimburser_id = #{reimburserId}, reimburser_name = #{reimburserName}, reimburser_no = #{reimburserNo}, business_type_id = #{businessTypeId}, business_type_name = #{businessTypeName}, remarks = #{remarks}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip a INNER JOIN trip b ON a.reimbursement_id = b.reimbursement_id AND a.id < b.id AND a.start_date <= b.end_date AND b.start_date <= a.end_date WHERE a.reimbursement_id = #{reimbursementId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip WHERE reimbursement_id = #{reimbursementId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subsidy_calendar WHERE reimbursement_id = #{reimbursementId}
